text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: metering.ingest.consumer_lag > 15m for account-aggregator-service (prod) — potential undercounting of tokens and delayed invoice generation. link: https://pagerduty.example/INC12345

pagerduty: Incident INC12345 created and routed to billing_oncall. Escalation policy: billing-primary -> eng-platform -> eng-sre. Pager: paging now.

billing_oncall: acked. Investigating. I'm oncall: Sara.

sara: quick context: customers report missing tokens in latest invoice batch, alerts show ingestion lag + token delta in monitoring. Pulling logs now.

raj: I'm available to help — likely consumer backlog or a Kafka consumer stuck. Which topic?

sara: topic=usage-events-v2, consumer-group=account-aggregator-consumers, lag ~ 350k msgs across partitions. Check consumer offsets.

matt: I'm on infra. Looking at pods: metering-consumer-*. One pod in CrashLoopBackOff for last 8m. Others healthy but lagging. kubectl -n prod get pods | grep metering-consumer shows 3/4 running.

olivia: I see a schema change last deploy triggered a consumer to throw on unknown field. Error in logs: Exception: UnknownFieldError: field 'billing_tag' not in schema.

raj: that would cause the consumer to stop committing offsets if it crashes. Can we restart the crashloop pod and restart consumer? Quick mitigation: scale replicas to 6 to widen parallelism, then restart faulty pod for a rolling redeploy.

sara: attempting scale now: 
```
kubectl -n prod scale deployment metering-consumer --replicas=6
```

matt: scaling up. Also starting a manual restart of the crashloop pod to get it out of the bad state.

incident-bot: :information_source: Action logged: scaled metering-consumer -> 6 replicas by sara at 1808887855. Restart initiated for pod metering-consumer-2 at 1808887860.

raj: while infra acts, we should run a quick ad-hoc consumer with backwards-compatible schema to drain the backlog without failing on billing_tag. I'll spin a debug consumer image with relaxed schema.

olivia: I'll push a small schema patch to tolerate unknown fields and create a canary image. Deploying canary image as metering-consumer-canary (1 replica).

sara: deployed canary. Logs show it started and began processing partitions. Consumer lag dropping from 350k -> 200k in ~6m.

matt: Crashloop pod is restarted and now healthy. Replica count at 6. Cluster CPU spike during catch-up but within limits.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Monitor: lag decreasing, current total lag ~90k. Notifying eng-platform and billing team to hold invoices until counts validated.

sara: billing action: pausing automatic invoice generation for today batch id=2026-11-27-03 so we don't ship undercounts. Manual hold placed in billing UI. Notifying affected customers with templated note.

raj: once backlog drains to <5k, we should run a reconciliation job to recompute token counts for last 12h window and ensure invoice amounts match. Plan: run tools/reconcile_tokens.py --window 12h --dry-run then commit.

olivia: patched consumer image pushed to prod tag: metering-consumer:v2026.11.27-schema-tolerant. Rolling update queued.

matt: I'll keep an eye on infra; if lag flattens we'll scale down consumers to original replicas to save cost. Also checking for duplicate processing risks during backfill.

sara: running dry-run reconcile now. Sample output: 
```
reconcile summary (dry-run): window=12h; expected_tokens=4,512,320; observed_ingested=4,427,850; delta=84,470 (1.87%); Top accounts affected: acct_2345 (45k), acct_7788 (20k)
```

raj: those deltas line up with lag we saw. Backfill target: process offsets [oldest..committed] for affected partitions. I'll kick off backfill worker next. ETA ~25m.

incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: Escalation to eng-platform due to potential invoice impact. Noted at 1808888100.

olivia: can we run a targeted fast-path backfill for the top 10 impacted accounts to unblock any immediate invoice disputes?

sara: yes please — priority on accounts with outstanding invoice disputes. I'll flag them in billing system.

raj: kicked off targeted backfill job: `python tools/backfill_tokens.py --accounts acct_2345,acct_7788 --window 12h`. Logs show processing started.

matt: infra note: increased consumer replicas earlier causing short-lived 30% CPU spike. No node OOMs. Monitoring alert thresholds temporarily suppressed for the catch-up window.

incident-bot: Update: lag down to ~6k at 1808888400. Backfill job processing top accounts.

sara: reconcile dry-run after partial backfill: expected=4,512,320; observed=4,506,900; delta=5,420 (0.12%). This is within tolerance; marking invoices as safe to generate for untouched customers.

sara: manual review: for the top affected accounts we'll wait until full reconcile completes. Reopening billing holds only for those accounts and proceeding for others. Sending status email to finance and support.

raj: full backfill still running; ETA ~8m. If it completes without data duplication, we can re-run final reconcile and unpause holds.

matt: crashloop cause identified and fixed in schema-tolerant image. Adding a consumer integration test to CI to catch unknown-field errors. Issue created: GH-issue-485.

incident-bot: Incident INC12345 status: mitigated -> partial (customer holds in place for 2 accounts). Next steps: complete backfill, final reconcile, unpause holds, postmortem. Assigned: raj (backfill), olivia (deploy rollback/ci fix), matt (infra review), sara (billing ops & customer comms).

sara: handing off to night oncall: billing_oncall -> raj (eng-ml) at 1808888976. I'll remain reachable.

raj: ack — taking over. Will update thread when backfill completes.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Acknowledged handoff logged.

sara: thx team :thumbsup:
